info.name: Shipzy Backend API (Docs Synced)
info.description:
Generated from backend/docs/api/*.md.
Set token variables before running protected requests:
- accessToken (client/general)
- courierAccessToken
- businessAccessToken
- adminAccessToken

Base URL defaults to local backend.
